intentionalOmissions.reason: The compact 96 px lockup omits the tagline to preserve legibility.

intentionalOcclusions.reason: The connector intentionally crosses the joined initials.
The small connector terminals intentionally touch the joined initials at their attachment points.
The small center joint intentionally pins the mirrored initials at their shared axis.

textures.label: Micro Grid
textures.description: A tiled square grid with optional subdivisions for restrained technical structure.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary mark already uses a dense cell grid.

textures.label: Diagonal Hatch
textures.description: One evenly spaced diagonal stroke family for economical print-like shading.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when narrow glyph counters could collapse.

textures.label: Crosshatch
textures.description: Two opposing stroke families that create a compact engraved field.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the symbol already contains many intersections.

textures.label: Halftone Dots
textures.description: A regular dot screen with deterministic radius modulation for printed tonal rhythm.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the smallest output is below 128 pixels wide.

textures.label: Seeded Stipple
textures.description: A repeatable seeded point field that adds tactile grain without external imagery.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the silhouette depends on tiny negative spaces.

textures.label: Topographic Lines
textures.description: Procedural contour-like paths that suggest terrain and layered surfaces.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary pattern is already a contour fingerprint.

textures.label: Voronoi Mosaic
textures.description: A seeded space-filling cell field with discrete palette assignment.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary pattern already uses Voronoi shards.

textures.label: Guilloche Waves
textures.description: Phase-shifted harmonic lines for currency-like ornamental detail.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary pattern already uses a wave baseline.

textures.label: Woven Checker
textures.description: Orthogonal bands with an alternating over-under crossing schedule.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary mark already uses a letter weave.

textures.label: Directional Fibers
textures.description: Short parallel strokes with seeded displacement for directional material grain.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when a crisp institutional seal is required.

textures.label: Hex Cell Lattice
textures.description: A staggered field of regular hexagon outlines for modular scientific identities.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the mark already relies on honeycomb or hexagonal geometry.

textures.label: Triangle Flip Tiles
textures.description: Equilateral triangle facets whose fills alternate by orientation and grid parity.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when small counters cannot preserve the triangular facet rhythm.

textures.label: Truchet Arc Links
textures.description: Seeded quarter-circle tiles that join into deterministic flowing routes.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary symbol already contains routed arc networks.

textures.label: Houndstooth Blocks
textures.description: Offset notched polygons that form a bold houndstooth textile repeat.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when a quiet or minimal luxury treatment is required.

textures.label: Argyle Diamonds
textures.description: Staggered filled diamonds crossed by sparse seam threads.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the logo already contains dominant diamond geometry.

textures.label: Running Brick Bond
textures.description: Rectangular modules arranged in half-offset masonry rows.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when rigid masonry cues conflict with the brand personality.

textures.label: Isometric Cube Tiles
textures.description: Three rhombus faces repeat as compact axonometric cube units.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary mark already uses an isometric block stack.

textures.label: Greek Key Meander
textures.description: A continuous orthogonal fret path that forms a seamless border-like field.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the available fill area is too narrow to show complete turns.

textures.label: Chainmail Rings
textures.description: Split ring arcs alternate front and back to create linked metallic rhythm.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when ring crossings would compete with thin lettering.

textures.label: Seigaiha Fans
textures.description: Discrete staggered fans built from nested semicircular arcs.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the concept should not suggest water, waves, or heritage ornament.

textures.label: Knit V Loops
textures.description: Curved V-shaped stitches interlock in staggered knitted rows.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when textile or hand-crafted cues are inappropriate.

textures.label: Pinwheel Quilt
textures.description: Four rotated triangle patches form a repeating pinwheel block.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when multiple palette faces would make the mark visually busy.

textures.label: Star Kite Lattice
textures.description: Eight-point stars and surrounding kite polygons form a precise ornamental lattice.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the silhouette is too small to preserve star points.

textures.label: Chevron Bands
textures.description: Closed filled zigzag ribbons create a strong directional cadence.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary mark already has aggressive directional motion.

textures.label: Pixel Staircase
textures.description: Integer-aligned rectangles form diagonal stepped bands with a digital character.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the desired identity should feel organic or handcrafted.

textures.label: Terrazzo Chips
textures.description: Independent seeded polygon chips float over a flat substrate without sharing boundaries.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the primary form already uses fragmented polygon facets.

textures.label: Linocut Gouges
textures.description: Tapered curved negative cuts emulate hand-carved linocut marks.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when pristine geometric precision is central to the identity.

textures.label: Letterpress Slippage
textures.description: A repeated stamp receives a controlled second impression with visible registration offset.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when any registration error would undermine a precision-focused brand.

textures.label: Dry Roller Bands
textures.description: Broad bands break into deterministic ink runs and substrate gaps.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when distressed print texture would weaken small-size recognition.

textures.label: Embossed Lozenges
textures.description: Paired light and dark offset faces imply lozenge relief without gradients.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when flat one-color reproduction is the primary delivery mode.

textures.label: Camouflage Islands
textures.description: Seeded closed blobs overlap into a repeatable organic island field.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when camouflage, outdoor, or tactical associations are undesirable.

textures.label: Leaf Vein Repeat
textures.description: Repeated leaf silhouettes carry a midrib and mirrored secondary veins.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when botanical or sustainability cues would be misleading.

textures.label: Pinecone Scales
textures.description: Pointed lens-shaped scales overlap in staggered natural rows.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the mark already uses feather, scale, or petal geometry.

textures.label: Coral Branchlets
textures.description: Bounded recursive forks form connected microbranch colonies.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when thin branches cannot survive the smallest required reproduction.

textures.label: Circuit Traces
textures.description: Seeded Manhattan routes connect compact terminal pads across a coarse lattice.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when technology or electronics associations do not support the brief.

textures.label: Barcode Cadence
textures.description: A brand hash generates a repeatable sequence of variable-width vertical bars.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when barcode or retail associations would distract from the brand.

textures.label: Microtype Ribbons
textures.description: The supplied brand or tagline repeats in offset microtype rows behind the primary wordmark.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when the texture copy cannot remain secondary to the primary wordmark.

textures.label: Morse Stripes
textures.description: A fixed Morse table converts supplied copy into aligned dot-dash rows.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when dot-dash encoding could be mistaken for unreadable primary text.

textures.label: Radial Calibration
textures.description: Compact repeated dials combine discrete rings with major and minor radial ticks.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when instrument, measurement, or precision cues conflict with the brief.

textures.label: Seven Segment Code
textures.description: A brand hash selects digits rendered through a fixed seven-segment glyph grid.
textures.avoidWhen: Avoid when a retro-digital display aesthetic is inappropriate.
